sections.title: Form and range
sections.text: A rare woody liana of humid tropical forests in central and western Africa. Its stems climb through vegetation with the help of leaf hooks.

sections.title: Leaves and seeds
sections.text: Leaves change shape during development; some leaves on mature plants bear hooks. The seeds have membranous wings that aid dispersal.

sections.title: Growth habit
sections.text: Despite its occasional association with carnivorous plants, Dioncophyllum thollonii is not carnivorous. Leaf traps described in another member of the family should not be attributed to it.
